listing.name: Onslaught Mk1 Enhanced
listing.summary: Enchances and fixes many of the Mk1's modular ship issues!
listing.aiSummary: Fixes and enhances the vanilla Onslaught Mk1 modular ship, adding an armor preview and correcting targeting and armor behavior.

description:
Onslaught Mk1 Enhanced

Enchances and fixes many of the Mk1's modular ship issues!

Adds a armor paperdoll preview to ship info!

Spoiler

Fixes explosions bypassing modular armor!

Spoiler

Fixes enemies targeting armor as if it's a dangerous ship!

After working on Knights of Ludd and Scy, modular ships have been my bread and butter. This is a mini mod for the new vanilla modular ship that includes all the fixes/enhancements I developed for those mods.

Changelog:

Spoiler
Version 1.0.3
- Fixed another NPE

Version 1.0.2
- Fixed duplicated .ship contents (resulting in duplicated mounts)

Verison 1.0.1
- Fixed NPE

Verison 1.0.0
- Initial Release

aiDescription: Fixes issues with the vanilla Onslaught Mk1 modular ship, including explosions bypassing armor and enemies incorrectly targeting armor. Adds an armor paperdoll preview to the ship info screen. Includes enhancements and fixes developed for other modular ship mods.
